entries: {first} heard {SOMEONE:human,!plural} at {landmark} {MANNER}, and the house went still.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and the room grew cold.
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:human,!plural} long after the funeral, asking {first} to come to {landmark}.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} appeared {MANNER}, and {first} was the only one to see.
The {rival} wanted {landmark} sold, and {first} heard {SOMEONE:human,!plural} refuse.
{SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} and asked {first} to stay.
A bell rang at {landmark}, and {first} found {THING} where {DISASTER:strikes} had left it.
